brief: Goldman Sachs Prime Services weekly report, data through 9/24/26 over 5 trading days. GS's Equity Fundamental L/S performance estimate rose 0.90% versus MSCI World's 0.16%, driven by short-side alpha of 0.57%. The Systematic L/S estimate fell 0.33% on long-side alpha losses of 0.23%. Overall book gross leverage eased 1.2 points to 308.0% and net leverage eased 0.2 points to 77.3%. Global equities were net sold for the first time in five weeks, short sales outpacing long sales 1.6 to 1, hitting all major regions except Europe and 7 of 11 global sectors. Info Tech, Financials, and Consumer Discretionary were the sectors most net bought. Industrials saw its largest percentage net selling in three months, short driven 4.5 to 1, while the book stays 3.8% overweight the sector versus MSCI World. Financials was Europe's most net bought sector, its largest percentage buying in six months, long driven 6.8 to 1, even as the book remains 6.0% underweight versus MSCI Europe. The report presents observed hedge fund flow and leverage data only, with no stated market view.
